name: Trakines
description: Play with Layout Mode while OBS shows the normal render via Spout2

enable_layout_mode.name: Layout Mode
enable_layout_mode.description: Enables Layout Mode (simplified hitboxes, no deco) for gameplay

enable_spout_output.name: Spout2 Output
enable_spout_output.description: Sends the normal (non-layout) render to OBS via Spout2

spout_sender_name.name: Spout Sender Name
spout_sender_name.description: Name of the Spout2 sender that OBS will capture

mirror_resolution_w.name: Mirror Render Width
mirror_resolution_w.description: Resolution width for the Spout2 mirror render

mirror_resolution_h.name: Mirror Render Height
mirror_resolution_h.description: Resolution height for the Spout2 mirror render

mirror_fps.name: Mirror Render FPS
mirror_fps.description: Target FPS for the Spout2 mirror render (throttled to save GPU)
